text.en: The sitios of Binaloan, Canbagahay, Dacol, Upper Danao, Bongdo II, Pangabotan and Gayaro, all in the Municipality of Taft, Province of Eastern Samar, are hereby converted into barrios to be known as Barrios Binaloan, San Pablo, Dacol, Del Remedios, Beto, Pangabotan and Gayam, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
